description: Finite source-supported trace of Download pk/root authorization, version selection, and original/archive file choice.

upstream: DRF authentication and global permission outcomes, guardian object-grant state, and deployment storage availability remain runtime facts outside the finite inputs.
The workflow models the inquiry's authenticated actor; actual ownership and object grants are not assumed.

assumptions.text: The operation under investigation is the document Download operation in this Paperless revision.
Ownership and object grants are unspecified.

coverage.reason: Source order is modeled; actual authentication, global permission, and throttle outcomes are runtime facts.

call.reason: The caller invokes the helper only for a non-null user; the helper then constructs the checker before evaluating its return expression.
The grant call runs only when a non-null user's owner bypasses fail, and its returned Boolean controls authorization.

coverage.reason: Integer-conversion failure remains a named executable limitation.

steps.because: The DefaultRouter registers UnifiedSearchViewSet under the documents prefix.
download is a GET detail action and delegates to file_response with attachment disposition.
APIView.initial performs authentication, global permission checks, and throttling before dispatch reaches the action handler.
DocumentViewSet configures these two global permission classes.
PaperlessObjectPermissions maps GET to the model view permission; DRF checks it before dispatch.
A missing pk lookup raises Http404 before root resolution or authorization.
file_response resolves the pk with include_deleted=True, so the request/root lookup uses the global manager rather than the visible-only manager.
The action-level owner-aware permission call is evaluated only when request.user is not None.

steps.name: ObjectPermissionChecker.construct
steps.because: When the caller supplies a non-null user, has_perms_owner_aware constructs ObjectPermissionChecker(user).
Normal construction is required only on the non-null-user branch.
Within the invoked helper, an unowned root or a root owned by the user short-circuits the grant lookup.
Only the non-null-user branch whose owner checks fail reaches checker.has_perm.

steps.name: ObjectPermissionChecker.has_perm
steps.because: checker.has_perm is the right operand of the owner-aware Python or-expression.
When invoked, has_perm must return normally before its Boolean result controls authorization.
A null request.user skips the action-level helper; otherwise the owner-aware helper result decides.
The file path returns 403 if owner-aware view permission on the root document fails.
The action-specific owner-aware check applies view_document to the resolved root.
The caller short-circuits the action-level owner-aware check for a null request.user.
get_latest_version_for_root chooses the visible or global manager from include_deleted before querying versions.
Related versions are ordered newest-first and the first row is selected.

value.literal: version_index descending nulls-last, then id descending

steps.because: versions_newest_first defines the precise stable ordering used before first().
When no related version exists, the root document is returned.
query_params.get('version') returns null when the key is absent; explicit null remains null and an empty string remains present and falsy.
A non-null value, including an empty string, makes _resolve_file_doc include deleted versions.
Falsy version values select latest; truthy values are converted to an integer, with invalid conversion represented by the remaining named limitation.
A requested version document is preserved only when the version parameter is absent; otherwise resolution uses explicit, visible-latest, or all-latest branches.
Invalid, unrelated, or missing version resolution cannot reach serve_file.
A request whose pk names a version returns that exact version when no version query parameter is present.
The mode distinguishes absent, empty, and truthy version query values.
An invalid version raises DRF NotFound; absent or unrelated candidates raise Http404.
The root permission check precedes and is separate from effective version selection.
file_response returns on failed root authorization before calling _get_effective_file_doc.
After the root check, the selected file document is passed directly to serve_file without another owner-aware check.
file_response explicitly checks the root and then selects and serves file_doc without calling get_object/check_object_permissions for file_doc.
file_doc is resolved before original_requested and has_archive_version decide archive versus original.
The original flag is true only when the key exists with the exact string 'true'; absent keys default to null.
Archive is used unless original is exactly 'true', and only when the selected document has an archive version.
serve_file receives the archive decision after the file document is selected.
original/archive selection occurs only in the later serve_file call and does not replace the checked root document.
Archive responses force application/pdf; original responses use the selected document mime type, with text charset adjustments in the source.

value.literal: changes response filename only, not selected document or file handle

steps.because: Both representation branches choose their file handle independently of follow_formatting; that flag chooses the response filename.
The Download action delegates to file_response with attachment disposition.
The download action converts FileNotFoundError and Document.DoesNotExist into Http404.
